description.value: The Maple Ridge Leisure Centre Pool is a municipally operated aquatic facility within a larger multi-sport complex run by the City of Maple Ridge, offering swimming lessons and drop-in swim programs alongside skating, fitness, and racquet sports. Situated in central Maple Ridge at Haney Place, the facility participates in the city's Smart-Lock Bike Rack program, providing free secure bike parking on-site. For a touring cyclist, the combination of secure bike storage and mandatory pre-swim showers makes this a practical mid-route stop.
